text:
jen: Deploy complete to eu-west at 12:13 UTC. Running post-deploy quickchecks now. Observing higher prefill miss rate on kv-prefill agent. Anyone seeing the same?

deploy-bot: deploy/67890 -> green. smoke checks started: quickcheck-kv-prefill, heartbeat-resample, tokenization-sanity

sam: Yep, I'm seeing kv-prefill miss % jump from 0.3 -> 4.2 in eu-west3 around 12:20

lee: heartbeat p95 in eu-west is 210ms (baseline 95ms). prefix cache warmup not keeping up.

maria: Logs show repeated WARN on prefill sharded-loader: "chunk fetch timeout". sample log:
```
2026-03-20T12:20:31Z WARN sharded-loader fetch chunk 42 timeout 12000ms
```

jen: roll or hold? Current traffic is 20% canary. Prefill affects some routes (embeds batch). Can we route canary away from eu-west for now? @ops-bot any quick routing idea?

ops-bot: Suggestion: shift canary traffic to us-west via route-weight override. Command:
```
route set-weight --route embed-canary --region eu-west 0.0 --region us-west 1.0
```

sam: I'll apply route override for 10m, then re-run quickchecks. giving ops a heads up.

lee: Also recommend disabling prefetch sharding for this variant to avoid chunk timeouts (config flag: `prefill.shard_count=1`). Low-risk toggle.

maria: If we can't stabilize in 15m, prepare rollback. Nominate commit `a1b2c3d` for rollback target (previous stable). deploy-bot, ready?

deploy-bot: rollback prepared -> target a1b2c3d. To execute run:
```
deploy rollback --to a1b2c3d --scope canary
```

jen: Sam, apply routing now. Lee, patch and toggle shard count in the canary config.

sam: route set -> applied. quickchecks re-running.

lee: hotpatch sent to canary config: `prefill.shard_count=1`. patch id 4021.

maria: Quickchecks now: kv-prefill miss -> 0.9%, heartbeat p95 -> 110ms. Looks improved.

jen: Nice. Leave route override in for 30m and monitor. No rollback needed atm. Reminder to include this incident note in release notes explaining the temporary route and shard toggle.

ops-bot: Noting action items: route override applied (sam), shard toggle (lee), rollback standby prepared (maria). Monitoring window 30m.

jen: Thanks all. Close thread if stable. +1 for follow-up in release notes.
